caption.zh: DepthMaster 将针孔与 ERP 统一为透视面，联合虚拟相机条件、点图/法线预测、共享尺度与对应一致性训练。
caption.en: DepthMaster unifies pinhole and ERP as perspective patches with virtual-camera conditioning, point/normal prediction, shared scale and correspondence-consistency training.

credit.zh: 来源：Pengfei Wang et al.，原论文 Figure 3。
credit.en: Source: Pengfei Wang et al., Figure 3 of the paper.

caption.zh: OmniPoint 将图像与可选内参、稀疏深度条件输入 DINOv2，分别预测射线／径向距离、天空掩码与公制尺度。
caption.en: OmniPoint combines image and optional intrinsic/sparse-depth conditions in DINOv2, with ray-distance, sky-mask and metric-scale heads.

credit.zh: 来源：Botao Ye et al.，原论文 Figure 2。
credit.en: Source: Botao Ye et al., Figure 2 of the original paper.

caption.en: OmniRay combines composite camera rays with a radial-distance branch to form up-to-scale point maps.
caption.zh: OmniRay 将组合式相机射线与径向距离分支结合，构成整体尺度未确定的点图。

credit.en: Source: Namitha Guruprasad et al., Figure 2 of the original paper.
credit.zh: 来源：Namitha Guruprasad et al.，原论文 Figure 2。
